name: @schoolos/ai-governance
description: SchoolOS AI governance (roadmap G01): funding pools, model policy, an idempotent reserve/settle attribution ledger with budget caps, content-free usage reports, provider bill reconciliation, and the governor interface a kernel AI Gateway seam calls. Its `./durable-object-store` entry point is the ledger's Durable Object SQLite store. A library, not a deployable Worker.
